collections.title: Will AI actually help with this work?
collections.description: Start with comparisons and tradeoffs before adding more automation.

selections.title: When combinations of humans and AI are useful: A systematic review and meta-analysis
selections.why_selected: Tests the assumption that combining people and AI beats the stronger baseline.
selections.takeaway: On average, human-AI combinations performed worse than the better human-only or AI-only baseline. Effects varied: decision-making tasks showed losses, content-creation tasks showed gains, and augmentation depended on which side initially performed better.
selections.limits: The reviewed evidence is experimental and heterogeneous, with possible publication bias and differing study designs. Next: which coordination mechanisms improve the best-baseline comparison in sustained, privacy-constrained work?

selections.title: Shifting Work Patterns with Generative AI
selections.why_selected: Separates changes in individual work from changes in coordination.
selections.takeaway: Access to AI changed work that individuals could change independently, including less time spent on email and moderately faster document completion. It did not significantly change time spent in meetings, a coordination-dependent activity.
selections.limits: The report describes access and work-pattern effects, not the quality, safety, or persistence of cross-repository coordination. Next: which repeated-use measures observe handoff quality, correction, and ownership changes rather than only time use?

collections.title: Help people check the work and stay in control
collections.description: Understand where explanations and automation can mislead.

selections.title: Does the Whole Exceed its Parts? The Effect of AI Explanations on Complementary Team Performance
selections.why_selected: Shows why an explanation alone is not evidence of better decisions.
selections.takeaway: AI assistance produced some complementary performance, but explanations did not increase it. Explanations increased acceptance of recommendations whether they were right or wrong.
selections.limits: The tasks were bounded classification and reasoning tasks. Next: which outcome set captures quality, effort, reversibility, and accountability in open-ended work?

selections.title: Human Performance Consequences of Stages and Levels of Automation: An Integrated Meta-Analysis
selections.why_selected: Connects routine automation benefits with recovery and awareness tradeoffs.
selections.takeaway: Higher automation improved routine performance and workload but reduced situation awareness and failure performance, especially across the analysis-to-action-selection boundary.
selections.limits: The studies vary and mostly predate LLM systems. Next: do the same tradeoffs appear when generative agents move from analysis to consequential action?

collections.title: Recover interrupted work
collections.description: Inspect recovery mechanisms without assuming they make every action safe.

selections.title: temporalio/sdk-python
selections.why_selected: An established durable-workflow example for inspecting recovery design.
selections.takeaway: Deterministic workflows, activities and replay expose resumable state.
selections.limits: Requires a Temporal service and replay discipline. External effects still need idempotency. README inspected; no runtime test or adoption.
selections.original_evidence_note: Deterministic workflows, activities, replay and sandboxing expose resumable state. Requires a Temporal service and replay discipline; external effects still need idempotency. Pinned README screen only; no runtime test or adoption.

selections.title: hatchet-dev/hatchet
selections.why_selected: A second recovery design with a recorded version-specific counterexample to consider.
selections.takeaway: Durable tasks, execution history and pause/resume expose a recovery design.
selections.limits: Old retry work advancing after replacement was reported on an earlier release. Current-head behavior was not tested. Requires server and data-retention review; no collaboration benefit established.
selections.original_evidence_note: Pinned README describes durable tasks, Postgres-backed execution history, retries, pause/resume and worker routing. These expose recovery mechanisms, not safe supersession or agent collaboration benefit. Open issue 4900 reports old retry work advancing after replacement on an earlier release; current-head behavior was not tested. Requires a server and data-retention review before any operational use.

counterevidence.boundary: Publicly reported behavior on an earlier release; not reproduced or verified on this snapshot.
